newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to list Excite Inc options on Jan 20.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to list Excite Inc options on Jan 20.

text.p: Philadelphia Stock Exchange said Tuesday it will begin trading options on Excite Inc Jan 20.
The options would trade with intial expirations in February, March, May and August and opening strike prices of 7-1/2, 10 and 12-1/2.
The stock was unchanged at 10-1/2 Tuesday afternoon.
Park Avenue Securities is the specialist for Excite options, which will also trade on Chicago Board Options Exchange. ((Derivatives desk, 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
